about: The board's reach as Freeform's: `margin` board points past its outermost card or lane whatever the zoom (boardOf), with what the view showed when it last rested and while zooming (seenFrom, takeIn), so that its edge shows only while pulled. As web/camera.ts has it, which the Mac's BoardBounds mirrors. Rects are [x, y, w, h] in board points; an area is [left, top, right, bottom] in screen points; a camera is [x, y, zoom], the screen point of the board's origin.

extent.name: an empty board spans its origin
a card and a lane apart

board.name: an empty board is 2, 388 square, as Freeform's
what showed far to the left stretches it there
what showed within it changes nothing

seen.name: at 200 %, an area in from the screen's edge

takeIn.name: nothing seen yet takes what shows
a zoom out takes in more around it
a zoom in keeps what it showed
a pan then a zoom out takes in both
